summary: Vesta Real Estate Corporation filed a Form 6-K announcing the payment of the first installment of a dividend declared at its April 22, 2026 shareholders' meeting. The dividend is paid on May 6, 2026, for US$18,688,330.25, equivalent to approximately US$0.02181 per share. Payment is in Mexican pesos through Indeval, using the Bank of Mexico exchange rate from May 5, 2026. This is a routine distribution of capital to shareholders, not a transformative event. No special-situation catalysts such as large buyback, delisting, or activist campaign are involved. Watch for subsequent installments or changes in capital allocation policy, but no risk-arb angle applies.
